title: Find why the oversized committed-memory read test never finishes on macOS
outcome: Find why the oversized committed-memory read test never finishes on macOS
acceptance: The cause of task_sync::data_worktree::tests::memories::committed_memory_read_refuses_an_oversized_file_before_reading_any_body not finishing on the Mac is diagnosed and recorded (product hang, test setup cost, or environment)
On the Mac, `cargo test --lib task_sync` completes through the standard launcher with a final test-result summary and that test passing, run through the Mac runner's remote session

completion.summary: Closed as a no-code diagnosis. The original serial macOS task_sync run hit its 1,800-second outer deadline after 719 completed cases. On the unchanged commit, the oversized-memory test passed individually in 4.01 s and within the full four-thread selection in 3.984 s. The registered Mac runner completed 1,094 passed, 0 failed, and 2 ignored in 936.09 s. Independent acceptance attempt 2 passed both criteria on the same unchanged source. The unused fixture patch was withdrawn and its test ref deleted.
